answer_1.quote: In this research, we exploit these powerful LMMs to generate text from structured data (knowledge graph and table) with images.

answer_2.quote: We use automatic metrics to measure both faithfulness and saliency of generated text. We employ standard metrics BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L and BERTScore to measure saliency of the generated text by comparing it with the pre-processed ground-truth text. To verify the faithfulness of the generated text with respect to the input image(s), we utilize the CLIP score.
